semantics.payload_coordinate: all offsets in `evidence` are payload offsets (0 = first byte after the 512-byte MTK header); file offset = payload offset + 0x200 for container images
semantics.needle_mask: same length as needle in hex; each byte pair 'ff' = must match, '00' = wildcard; omitted = exact match
semantics.patch_offset: byte offset from the needle start where `patch` is written; all ARM32 rules patch at 0
semantics.patch_semantics_arm32: 00207047 = Thumb `movs r0,#0; bx lr` (shortest, same as lkpatcher default)
semantics.patch_semantics_arm32_pushpop: 08b5002008bd = Thumb `push {r3,lr}; movs r0,#0; pop {r3,pc}` (补丁 A, preserves the original push/pop framing; only valid when the stock first instruction is 08b5)
semantics.patch_semantics_aarch64: e0031f2ac0035fd6 = `mov w0, wzr; ret` (8 bytes at function entry)

mtk_layout_verified.size_field_semantics: payload length in bytes (the bytes that start at 0x200). VERIFIED: the next packed sub-image header (magic 0x58881688, name 'cert1') starts exactly at file offset 0x200+size = 0xD49D0. NOTE: docs/spec_lkpatch.md §2 called this '有效负载长度' which is correct, but some third-party code (tfast lk_image.py payload_of) slices data[0x200:size], which drops the last 512 payload bytes on these packed images.
mtk_layout_verified.container_layout: the 4 MB lk_a/lk_b file is a packed MTK lk partition: 12 concatenated sub-images with a 0x200 header each, 16-byte aligned: lk(payload 0xD47D0) @0x0, cert1 @0xD49D0, cert2 @0xD52A0, bl2_ext @0xD5880, cert1 @0x16AAE0, cert2 @0x16B3B0, aee @0x16B990, cert1 @0x231C60, cert2 @0x232530, lk_main_dtb @0x232B10, cert1 @0x265500, cert2 @0x265DD0. It is NOT 'payload + zero padding to 4 MB'.
mtk_layout_verified.do_not_patch: only the warning functions inside the first sub-image (lk) payload are modified; never touch the cert1/cert2 signature blobs, bl2_ext, aee or lk_main_dtb sub-images, and never rewrite the 0x200 header

AArch64 开机状态警告分发器：函数内 ADRP+ADD 引用 Orange State / Red State / OS Not Being Verified / Dismiss After 5 Seconds / Device Cannot Boot 中至少 2 条，且含 state 比较链（cmp w?,#1/#2/#3）与 5,000,000µs 延时常量（movz w0,#0x4b40; movk w0,#0x4c,lsl#16 = 006889528009a072）→ 函数入口改 mov w0,wzr; ret，同时去掉警告与 5 秒等待；原函数所有路径本来就 return 0

rules.description: AArch64 dm-verity 警告函数：函数内 ADRP+ADD 引用 dm-verity corruption / Your device is corrupt / It can't be trusted / Device will continue to bootup / tran_dm_fix / Device occur dm vertity corruption 中至少 2 条，且延迟循环使用 100,000µs 常量（movz w0,#0x86a0; movk w0,#1,lsl#16 = 00d490522000a072）重复 >=10 次（本样本 30 次 = 3.0 秒）→ 函数入口改 mov w0,wzr; ret；原函数为 void，调用方忽略返回值
